bagPolicy.summary: Single-compartment clutches or wallets up to 6 × 9 inches, or clear plastic or vinyl bags up to 12 × 12 × 6 inches, are allowed. All bags are searched at entry.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Use the Gilley’s Dallas parking area; an attendant directs guests to general or VIP parking. The lot accepts credit cards and does not offer prepaid event parking.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue FAQ does not publish a designated rideshare pickup or drop-off location.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Beer, wine and spirits are available for purchase. Food service is not normally provided unless announced in advance; outside food and drinks are prohibited.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Accessible seats are available when booking; ask parking staff for the closest accessible lot or use the drop-off directly in front. Request an assistive listening device at least two days ahead or an interpreter at least four weeks ahead.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Leaving the venue ends admission; a new ticket is needed to enter again.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The venue FAQ covers mobile ticket issues and box-office assistance but does not publish a routine will-call pickup procedure.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Doors usually open 60 minutes before showtime, but the individual event page controls. Expect metal-detector screening or a physical pat-down and a bag search.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
